cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: HYPE value totalHypeValueReturned recorded in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount when a user cancels a withdrawal request
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

caller_has_manager_role.meaning: the caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges

hype_buffer_after.meaning: HYPE amount tracked in hypeBuffer after the re-delegation completes

total_staked_after.meaning: HYPE amount recorded in totalStaked after the re-delegation completes

delegated_amount_after.meaning: HYPE amount delegated to validators for rewards after the re-delegation completes

stranded_hype_amount.meaning: HYPE value remaining in the StakingManager contract outside normal accounting: not recorded in totalStaked, not tracked in hypeBuffer, and not delegated to validators

assumptions: The re-delegation is triggered by a MANAGER_ROLE caller invoking redelegateWithdrawnHYPE after a user cancelled a withdrawal request.
The stranded HYPE is the portion of _cancelledWithdrawalAmount not recorded in totalStaked, not tracked in hypeBuffer, and not delegated to validators.
The report describes the stranded value as remaining in the StakingManager contract outside normal accounting.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the remainder loss occurs on every call or only when _cancelledWithdrawalAmount is not a multiple of 1e10; the conservation relation is stated at the amount level without a per-call remainder predicate.
Whether stranded HYPE is recoverable by any admin function is not specified, so the permanence of the stranding is not formalized.

limitations: The conservation relation is expressed at the amount level (stranded_hype_amount == 0) rather than as an exact remainder modulo 1e10 predicate, because the selected impact statement describes the stranded value outside accounting rather than a per-call remainder magnitude.
The report does not establish a concrete prior transaction amount or observed loss; the scenario is conditional on cancel-then-redelegate operations.
Only the stranded_value impact is formalized; other reported impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
